name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 134 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 134 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Settlers in the West Bank are intensifying attacks during the olive harvest, torching cars and trees, wounding farmers, and assaulting European diplomats, a US photographer and a French mayor. In Gaza, families are reuniting after a ceasefire while a 7‑year-old girl was killed by Israeli fire and UNICEF reports 340 children killed despite the ceasefire. The EU has condemned the settler attacks on diplomats and demanded accountability. The Board of Peace is urging Israel to admit Gaza technocrats and an international force. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Settlere i Vestbredden intensiverer angrepene under olivenhøsten, tenner på biler og trær, sårer bønder og angriper europeiske diplomater, en amerikansk fotograf og en fransk ordfører. I Gaza gjenforenes familier etter en våpenhvile mens en 7‑årig jente ble drept av israelsk ild og UNICEF rapporterer at 340 barn er drept til tross for våpenhvilen. EU har fordømt bosetterangrepene på diplomater og krevd ansvarlighet. Fredsstyret oppfordrer Israel til å ta imot Gaza-teknokrater og en internasjonal styrke. Konflikten forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
